name: priority:P1
description: Critical or blocking impact with no safe workaround.

name: priority:P2
description: Important impact with a viable workaround and no immediate critical risk.

name: priority:P3
description: Non-urgent improvement, localized debt, documentation, or low-impact optimization.

name: technical-task
description: Architecture, refactoring, performance, testing, security, or technical-debt work.

name: triage:agent
description: Issue triage was performed by an automated or coding agent.

description: Agent triage is awaiting maintainer review.

name: triage:confirmed
description: A maintainer confirmed the issue triage.
